defect.problem: The disclosed record verifies the case identity and citation, but it does not verify live-law currency. The lake treatment is explicitly unverified, with no completed progeny enumeration.
defect.proposed_fix: Keep the citation/existence assertion, but propagate the Unverified treatment status anywhere the case is used as current authority until treatment/progeny review is completed.

reasons: Lake identity confirms a SCOTUS case decided 1997-04-28 with official citation 520 U.S. 397.
Lake treatment has field_i_validity unverified, as_of_treatment null, edges empty, and progeny rows_cached 0, so live-law status is not established from the disclosed evidence.
residual_risks: No disclosed citator/progeny data can rule out later limiting, abrogating, or overruling treatment.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Treat the assertion as verified for identity/citation only, not as verified current good law.

defect.problem: Lens B does not decide holding support, but the present-tense legal proposition should not be promoted as current law on this disclosed record because treatment is unverified.
defect.proposed_fix: Either frame the holding explicitly as the historical holding of the case or complete treatment/progeny verification before presenting it as current live doctrine.

reasons: Support fidelity is outside this lens.

residual_risks: Lens A still must verify the holding text against the opinion if support review is required.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Add or preserve an adjacent Unverified treatment warning wherever the holding is rendered.

defect.evidence_quote: Status: Unverified — subsequent treatment not yet machine-verified.
defect.problem: The Anchor role may be appropriate pedagogically, but as a current-law anchor it is not treatment-verified from the disclosed record.
defect.proposed_fix: Keep the home role only with the Unverified treatment banner, or defer Anchor promotion until treatment/progeny verification is complete.

reasons: The page frontmatter lists the home as Section 1983 Liability and Qualified Immunity with role Anchor.
The lake record remains under_review and treatment/progeny have not been derived, so currency for anchor use is not verified.
residual_risks: The disclosed evidence does not show whether later authority limits the case's centrality in Section 1983 doctrine.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Render the Anchor role together with the Unverified treatment status until promotion.

reasons: The lake identity court is U.S. and court_level is scotus.
The authority_weight label Binding — SCOTUS matches the Supreme Court source; it is a hierarchy label, not a verified good-law label.
residual_risks: Binding weight does not itself establish that the case remains good law.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep the weight label visually tied to the separate Unverified treatment badge.
